ruling: The missing seam was slightly mis-posed. Source-valid corridor History preserves invariant residue rather than generally mapping to a new residue value. The UTO explicitly sends transport path into History plus Holonomy records, while the Residue/Quantum Field Bundle supplies connection and curvature for path-dependent transport. The correct next instance problem is therefore to type E013/E026 histories into connection/holonomy data on the residue bundle, not to force route history to equal invariant residue.
